data.item: STATEMENT OF PROFIT OR LOSS AND OTHER COMPREHENSIVE INCOME 31 March 2022 31 March 2021 Kshs’000 Kshs’000 Revenue 142,234 139,662 Fair value gain on biological assets 9,685 4,121 Cost of production (101,913) (85,479) Gross profit 50,006 58,304 Net operating costs (41,962) (53,644) Profit before taxation 8,044 4,660 Tax credit /(charge) 333 (2,910) Profit for the year 8,377 1,750 Revaluation surplus, net of tax 154,915 176,080 Total comprehensive income for the year 163,292 177,830 Basic and diluted earnings per share 0.26 0.05 STATEMENT OF FINANCIAL POSITION 31 March 2022 31 March 2021 Kshs’000 Kshs’000 EQUITY Share capital 40,196 40,196 Revaluation reserve 1,003,639 857,585 Retained earnings 129,145 111,907 1,172,980 1,009,688 Non-current liabilities 97,315 86,519 Current liabilities 25,726 20,286 Total equity and liabilities 1,296,021 1,116,493 REPRESENTED BY:- Non-current assets 1,153,985 1,003,295 Current assets 142,036 113,198 1,296,021 1,116,493 STATEMENT OF CHANGES IN EQUITY Share Revaluation Retained Total capital surplus earnings Kshs’000 Kshs’000 Kshs’000 Kshs’000 At 1 April 2021 40,196 857,585 111,907 1,009,688 Profit for the year - - 8,377 8,377 Revaluation surplus on freehold land, net of tax - 154,915 - 154,915 Transfer of excess depreciation - (8,861) 8,861 - At 31 March 2022 40,196 1,003,639 129,145 1,172,980 STATEMENT OF CASH FLOWS 31 March 2022 31 March 2021 Kshs’000 Kshs’000 Net cash generated from operating activities 8,908 36,597 Net cash generated from/(used in) financing activities 919 (37,622) Net increase / (decrease) in cash and cash equivalents 9,827 (1,025) Cash and cash equivalents at the beginning of the year 1,256 3,849 Effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalents (1,406) (1,568) Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the year 9,677 1,256 RESULTS SUMMARY The above are extracts of the Financial Statements of Eaagads Limited that were approved by the Board of directors on 29th July 2022. These accounts were audited by Ernst & Young LLP, Certified Public Accountants and received an unqualified audit opinion. PERFORMANCE In the year under review, the company produced 188 tons of coffee compared to 233 tons last year. The decrease in the yield was mainly attributed to unfavorable weather conditions resulting in a lower late crop harvest. Despite the fall in the crop yield, sales incomes grew by Kshs 2.6 million, up from Kshs. 139 million last year to Kshs. 142 million. Crop prices averaged USD 6.90 per kilogram compared to USD 5.52 per kilogram last year and this was as a result of increased focus on direct sales, improved coffee bean quality and higher international coffee prices. To ensure sustainability of the coffee bushes, various intense coffee upkeep activities were undertaken to boost future productivity pushing the cost upwards by Kshs. 16 million. Farm management fees remained constant at USD 90 per hectare. The company revalued its freehold land (44 hectares) resulting in a revaluation gain of Kshs. 155 million. The remaining land which measures 341 hectares is held on a leasehold basis and is not subjected to valuation in line with the International Accounting Standards OUTLOOK The future of the farm looks promising as evidenced by the good flowering exhibited on the trees for 2022/23 production season. The company is on course towards achieving its early crop harvest of 200 tons and a late crop harvest of 150 Tons. Although the weather forecasts indicate depressed rainfall patterns, Eaagads farm management continues to put in place measures to ensure attainment of the crop projections. International coffee market prices have also greatly improved due to increased demand. According to ICO, Production for 2022-23 coffee season is expected to be lower than the demand mainly due to an anticipated low production in the South America coffee buffer zones. Looking ahead, the prices are likely to remain attractive as the world looks at depressed production. Eaagads coffee continues to attract a premium in the market due to its superior coffee quality. The farm continues to be managed by Coffee Management Services Ltd. DIVIDEND The board of directors do not recommend payment of a dividend for the year ended 31 March 2022 (31 March 2021: Nil) By the Order of the Board Company Secretary 29th July 2022
